commit.commitDidNotCompleteYourDraftIsPr.en: Commit did not complete. Your draft is preserved.
commit.commitDidNotCompleteYourDraftIsPr.zh-CN: 提交未完成，草稿已保留。

commit.commitIncludesAllStagedFilesInclu.en: Commit includes all {{staged}} Staged files, including files hidden by a path filter.
commit.commitIncludesAllStagedFilesInclu.zh-CN: 提交包含全部 {{staged}} 个已暂存文件，包括被路径筛选隐藏的文件。

commit.resolveAllConflictsBeforeCommit.zh-CN: 请先解决全部 {{conflicts}} 个冲突，再提交。

commit.stageChangesBeforeCommittingOrUse.en: Stage changes before committing, or use Amend to edit the last Commit message.
commit.stageChangesBeforeCommittingOrUse.zh-CN: 请先暂存更改再提交，或使用“修订提交”编辑上一次提交消息。

commit.draftsSaveAutomaticallyCancelEsca.en: Drafts save automatically. Cancel, Escape and Close keep your message.
commit.draftsSaveAutomaticallyCancelEsca.zh-CN: 草稿自动保存，取消、Esc 和关闭均保留 Message。
